idea-plugin.name: MaterialSymbolIcon
idea-plugin.description:
A unified tool to download, convert, and manage icons (Google Material Symbols, Apple SF Symbols, and SVG images) for Jetpack Compose ImageVector and Android XML Drawables.
Features:
  • Material Symbols: Direct URL download, vector conversion, and auto-naming.
  • SF Symbols: Paste raw SVG copied from Apple SF Symbols app with automatic cleanup of Apple-specific tags.
  • SVG Images: Browse or drag-and-drop local SVG files.
  • Jetpack Compose & XML Drawables: Instant generation of Compose ImageVector Kotlin code and Android Vector Drawables.
  • Central Registry: Automatically appends imported icons to your project's AppIcons.kt using IntelliJ Kotlin PSI.

action.description: Import Material Symbols, SF Symbols, and SVG icons for Compose and Android XML
